author: nrfrh_azn
title: Looking for illustrator for YA fantasy novel
content: 🎨 Calling all fantasy illustrators! I’m looking for an illustrator for my upcoming YA fantasy novel. Think dark academia, ancient magic, mysterious towers and an elegant, atmospheric fantasy aesthetic. If you create fantasy book covers, I’d love to see your portfolio! Please DM me your artwork, rates and estimated turnaround time. Recommendations are welcome too!

title: Looking for illustrator or digital artist
content: I’m looking for an illustrator or digital artist! If you’re interested, DM me your portfolio along with your rates. Let’s work together! Thread includes searching for artists for a project: Illustration, character art, concept art, portraits, graphic art—open to different styles. Paid work.

author: veliraiyawrites
title: Looking for fantasy book map designer + character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. For character art: more realistic, epic fantasy concept art. For the map: detailed and immersive with classic fantasy-map feel. Open to styles, bonus for POC and variety of ethnicities.

author: maitespena
title: Seeking illustrators for book character promo art
content: 🚨Se buscan ilustradores 📢 Busco quien nos ilustre una serie de personajes, teniendo en cuenta que no todos serán humanos. Son imágenes para redes sociales, para promocionar nuestro libro. No para venderlas ni para ilustrar páginas. Sencillas, de personajes a solas o en grupo (se pedirán varias). Por favor, agradecería que añadierais vuestro portfolio y una lista de precios. También podéis escribirme en privado si lo preferís. Gracias. (Adult novel, some non-human characters including demons and magical beings. Style with a simple touch due to humor.)

title: Looking for artists with availability through end of 2026
